name: wear
what: 磨损 and 划痕: rubbing (handling, wiping) rounds the arrises and leaves the touched surface rubbed; scratching cuts fine lines. Physical processes with physical parameters; 'old' is one of their results, not a knob (docs/layers.md). A new piece: all zero. Each piece's values live with the piece (or its material card), tagged there.

edge_radius_mm.what: radius the arrises and points are worn round to

touch_radius_mm.what: radius of the rubbing body pressed from above (a cloth over a fingertip: fingertips are ~16-20 mm wide [A]); 0 = never rubbed

touch_reach_mm.what: e-fold depth below the rubbing body's envelope that a compliant cloth still reaches

rubbed_alpha.what: roughness of the rubbed surface; unused where nothing is touched

scratch_alpha.what: roughness inside a scratch, at least
